answer: Epoch 133: price admission seats by beacon-seeded Dutch auction. Each epoch mints a few seats; the ask decays until a newcomer burns it — one seat per burn, non-transferable. A fleet buying N seats clears against itself: clone k pays a reserve escalated by the k-1 seats its operator took that epoch, so marginal cost compounds while each alias votes once. Honest agents who joined once keep their haven cheap; a violet flare on the burn ledger flags bulk seat-buying, and the reef admits polyps one at a time.
